definitions: A business model that recruits members via a promise of payments or services for enrolling others into the scheme, rather than supplying investments or sale of products.
A non-sustainable business model that involves recruiting an ever-increasing base of investors in a hierarchy, where each new investor pays the person who recruited them.
examples: Many people lost money in the pyramid scheme.
She was wary of joining what looked like a pyramid scheme.
The company was exposed as a pyramid scheme.
synonyms: multi-level marketing (often used interchangeably, though not always identical)
